item.title: Hime-sama wa Princess
item.description:
ゲーム情報

  • ブランド: Lover Soul
  • 発売日: 2009-06-19
  • スコア: 5.7299999999999995/10 (13 人評価)
  • 日本語名: 姫さまはプリンセス
  • 英語名: Hime-sama wa Princess

あらすじ

Shinobu is a boy with cute face like a girl. One day, he starts working at a house as a live-in butler. Like this, his new life with Lucia, a beautiful princess, begins…

Lucia doesn’t like men, but she gradually gets attracted to Shinobu’s cute face. If Shinobu makes the right choices, he will have a happy life with her. However, if he makes a mistake, he will be fooled by Christine, a live-in housemaid, and Lucia will be also tricked into playing with him. It all depends on Shibonu if he will be the main character of a happy love story or a plaything of the girls…

item.title: Harumoi
item.description:
ゲーム情報

  • ブランド: Lover Soul
  • 発売日: 2006-04-14
  • スコア: なし (4 人評価)
  • 日本語名: 春萌～はるもい～
  • 英語名: Harumoi

别名

  • Spring Moe ~ Hamoumo ~

あらすじ

Returning to Nogamo Moecho in Hokkaido, my birth place at the uncle’s funeral, Michiaki Fujikawa decided to spend a short period at my hometown until my college entrance ceremony with my aunt’s recommendation. What I’ve been waiting for in my hometown after five years is a nostalgic scenery, a cute little sister, a childhood friend who has become beautiful. And it was a mysterious beautiful girl who met her for the first time.

  • スコア: なし (1 人評価)
  • 日本語名: 盗んでMyHeart
  • 英語名: Nusunde MyHeart

あらすじ

Tokyo, 21st century.

City drown in a long recession is shocked by a series special theft crimes. The swiftest of those phantom thieves is red-haired girl Kaito Bunny the Taker.

Main character is an orphanage boy adopted by Fujinomiya family. His acquaintance with Ryoko girl from this family strangely coincides with the beginning of thefts.
